574-3678-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 white Kor Ally creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-3678-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

687-3796-4613-5231-8130.description:
Cast Gleaming Overseer by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Gleaming Overseer enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Gleaming Overseer and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Gleaming Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-3796-4613-5231-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

1315-3234-3293-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-8095.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-8095.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

261-997-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-997-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2738-4314-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

654-4772-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3129-4365-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Primal Vigor and Mondrak.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
3129-4365-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2348-4019-4974--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-4019-4974--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

129-1409-6723-7296.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1115-1409-3099-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3443-4644-7791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-4644-7791.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Deathbloom Ritualist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

1806-2060-5686-6774-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

4222-6788-7280.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
4222-6788-7280.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
4222-6788-7280.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

997-3991-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
997-3991-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

2533-4681-5256-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Chameleon.
Repeat.

4644-7163-7172.description:
Activate Sunken Palace's second ability by paying {1}{U}, tapping it and exiling seven cards from your graveyard, adding {U}.
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, ensuring to use the mana from Sunken Palace, targeting a triggered ability.
Sunken Palace triggers. Holding priority, activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {1}{R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sunken Palace trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting a Sunken Palace trigger.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6.

7124-7129.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
An opponent cannot block and kill Thorncaster Sliver.
7124-7129.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Thorncaster Sliver as attackers.
Thorncaster Sliver triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
7124-7129.notes: If you control other Slivers, you can use them instead of Thorncaster Sliver.

1379-1651-4702-4891.description:
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat

2438-5220-5931-6900.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2438-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2301-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2301-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1247-1355-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two enchantments.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1355-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sanctum Weaver's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

282-2034-2198-3094.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2034-2198-3094.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Deceiver Exarch.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Deceiver Exarch that is tapped and attacking.
When the Deceiver Exarch token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Lithoform Engine and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Deceiver Exarch token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1652-2146-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-2146-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

337-719-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
337-719-4222-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

1303-2232-2766-3872.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Swamp and at least one Forest that enter the battlefield untapped.
You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
You have at least one Swamp card and at least one Forest card that enter the battlefield untapped in your graveyard.
1303-2232-2766-3872.description:
Activate a Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
When Molderhulk enters the battlefield, it, Necroduality and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Molderhulk.
When the Molderhulk token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Swamp enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Swamp from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger from step 4, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Land's Edge twice by discarding the Swamp and Forest, dealing 4 damage to any player or planeswalker.
Repeat.

575-897-3703-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-897-3703-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Branchsnap Lorian.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Branchsnap Lorian enters the battlefield, Sporemound ttriggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1636-2108-3857-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 2.
1636-2108-3857-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Parasitic Strix.
When Parasitic Strix dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Parasitic Strix on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Parasitic Strix from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Parasitic Strix enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Parasitic Strix trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and for target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

565-914-4560.manaNeeded: {2}{U/R}{U/R} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery card
565-914-4560.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant and/or sorcery card in hand that can target a creature.
Opponents control a number of enchantments equal to or greater than five plus the mana value of the instant or sorcery card.
565-914-4560.description:
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery card you cast into your hand instead of your graveyard as it resolves.
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of artifacts and/or enchantments opponents control.
Resolve the instant or sorcery spell, returning it to your hand.
Activate any number of Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/R}{U/R} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery card.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any permanents you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

1379-4027-4050-4814.description:
Cast Glint Hawk by paying {W}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Myr, adding {W}.
Glint Hawk enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1799-2034-2048-4829.notablePrerequisites: At least eight of your ten sticker sheets have a name sicker with three unique vowels.
1799-2034-2048-4829.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing _____ Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting _____ Goblin from your graveyard on the bottom of your library and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheets.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting _____ Goblin from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then onto the battlefield.
_____ Goblin enters the battlefield, getting a name sticker and adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-3035-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nadier.
Nadier leaves the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Elf Warrior tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The tokens leave the battlefield, triggering Nadier's first ability twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Nadier.
Repeat.

147-1638-2060-4772.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4274-5141.description:
Float at least {4}{W}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Teferi's Protection for {2}{W}, phasing out all of your permanents.
Cast Apocalypse for {2}{R}{R}{R}, discarding your hand and exiling all permanents.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, your permanents phase back in.
